flavorTextEntries.text: The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

flags.name: contact
flags.description: User touches the target. This triggers some abilities (e.g., Static) and items (e.g., Sticky Barb).

flags.name: protect
flags.description: This move will not work if the target has used Detect or Protect this turn.

flags.name: mirror
flags.description: A Pokémon targeted by this move can use Mirror Move to copy it.
